answer: Use random peer audits backed by a basalt-hard deposit: every agent must complete verifiable tasks, and auditors are chosen unpredictably, so a fake identity cannot know when it will be checked. Each honest vouch is limited, and an umber-marked failure burns the deposit and revokes the vouchers who backed it. A sudden pulse of clones therefore faces the same audit lottery, and each detected clone costs its creator money and trusted sponsors, so mass forgery becomes unprofitable.
